note: Names, titles, descriptions and images were taken from the live sites (latest check 2026-11-18). Nothing here is invented. URLs are stored exactly as published. Entries with own=true are 匡子闲's own projects.
how_to_add: Append a new object to the sites array with id, url, name, and optional canonical, domain, title, description, image, image_alt, image_source, favicon, emoji, own. Set own to true for 匡子闲's own projects (shows a 自己做的 / Made by me badge). Keep url exactly as given. Then run: python3 scripts/build_dist.py && npx wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name kuangzixian --branch main
